name: artist-roulette
title: Artist Roulette
description: Suggests six artists (three from your rotation, two adjacent, one wild card) and starts a Spotify artist radio station from your pick.
author: christoomey

commands.name: spin
commands.title: Spin Artist Roulette
commands.subtitle: Spotify
commands.description: Suggest six artists and start a radio station from the one you pick.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Artist Roulette History
commands.subtitle: Spotify
commands.description: Browse past spins: what you were shown and what you picked.

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify Client ID
preferences.description: Client ID of your own Spotify app from developer.spotify.com/dashboard.

preferences.name: lastfmApiKey
preferences.title: Last.fm API Key
preferences.description: Free API key from last.fm/api/account/create. Used for artist similarity and charts.

preferences.name: adjacentMinListeners
preferences.title: Adjacent Minimum Listeners
preferences.description: Last.fm listener count an adjacent pick must clear. Lower means more obscure.

preferences.name: wildcardMinListeners
preferences.title: Wild Card Minimum Listeners
preferences.description: Last.fm listener count the wild card must clear. Raise for bigger names.
